title: Release Reviews

fields.label: What people are saying
fields.name: reviews
fields.instructions: Press quotes and chart placements for this record, shown on its page on the site in this order. An empty row is ignored.

sub_fields.label: Kind
sub_fields.name: kind

choices.quote: Quote — a review line, shown in quotation marks
choices.accolade: Accolade — a chart placement or award, shown plain

sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Leave it on Automatic and a sourced sentence reads as a quote, a placement like “Top 10” or an unsourced line as an accolade. Pick one to override. A placement that starts with “#”, a number or “Top” always shows as an accolade.

sub_fields.label: Quote or accolade
sub_fields.name: quote_or_accolade
sub_fields.instructions: Either a review quote or a placement like “Top 10 — October 2025”.

sub_fields.label: Source
sub_fields.name: source
sub_fields.instructions: Outlet or reviewer, e.g. “The Alternate Root”.

description: Press for this release. The page’s own text and lyric images stay the release story.
